THE JOURNAL

Notes from the field.

Long-form writing from mentors, members and the editorial team. Why we work the way we work.

ManifestoMay 14, 2026 · 5 min

What we actually do — and what we don't.

A short, plain answer for the question every parent eventually asks. We are not a school. We are not a camp. We are a structured runway from teenage potential to African leadership.

Funmi Akinwale · Founder
Anchor 128 min

Why twelve weeks. Not eight, not sixteen.

The shape of habit. Twelve is long enough to break the old self and short enough that a teenager will commit.

Discipline6 min

Discipline isn't a mood. It's a system you build around yourself.

Why we don't teach motivation. Why we do teach calendars, peer accountability and the small daily public commitment.

Curriculum12 min

African intelligence is the spine, not the seasoning.

What changes when you stop translating a foreign syllabus and start writing the original. Notes from year two of the curriculum.
